messages.message: Enable premium user accounts. Users can purchase credit and use it for special functions.

Page displayed when a user wants to use a premium function but has insufficient (or no) credit. It may be an internal page ID or a full URL (http://...).
Warning: If you have enabled automatic payments through third-party providers (such as PayPal), the default page (premium-feature-requested) must be used.

If credit can be purchased through payments, several conversion rates may be specified. For example, 5.00:10 means that EUR 5.00 in real money provides 10 units of premium credit. Note that decimals must be entered with a point (e.g. 4.99 instead of 4,99).
If users should be able to exchange premium credit for in-game money for their club, enter the value per premium unit here. Enter 0 if no exchange should be possible.
Premium credit automatically granted to a newly registered user upon registration.
